mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_messages (room_id, user_id, content, msg_type, created_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{msgType}, 'text'), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT msg.id, msg.room_id, msg.user_id, msg.content, msg.msg_type, msg.created_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.username) AS nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatar_url FROM room_messages msg LEFT JOIN users u ON msg.user_id = u.id WHERE msg.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY msg.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) t ORDER BY t.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
